facts.fact: K24 Digital reports the National Treasury's e-GP system, introduced in July 2025, had 402 tenders uploaded and 1,477 procuring entities listed on 21 October 2025, though no tender had been awarded through it.
K24 Digital read off the e-GP website that 402 tenders had been uploaded to the system by 21 October 2025.

KEN.note: Counties on-boarded to e-GP is a procurement application, not an office connection.
